content_html_sanitized:
"I have a question.   Does marijuana use have any impact on muscle growth?"

My Answer: It depends on how heavy your bong is.

Actually, I have never seen any research on that, but I am sure that the prohibitionists claim that it does. One bit of anecdotal evidence to the contrary: Big Arnold smoked pot while he was competing successfully in body building.  Of course, as with everything else, any effects would be dose related. Maybe Arnold just smoked a whole lot.

I would be interested to see anything you find on the subject.

Best wishes

Dick Cowan
